g.text: Dashed arrow = «import» dependency (UML 2.5), read from the
import statements of the code. Not drawn, to keep the diagram readable:
api, answer, handoff, procedure, retrieval and ingestion all import
models; answer, handoff and procedure import i18n; frontend imports
i18n and answer.language; scripts import procedure and answer.
language, prompts, LLM providers, verifier, answer service
Pydantic models of the API contract
libraries and systems outside the repository
